newsitem.title: UK: London youths jailed for raping Austrian tourist.
newsitem.headline: London youths jailed for raping Austrian tourist.

text.p: Seven London youths were jailed for 10 to 12 years each on Friday for gang-raping an Austrian tourist and then throwing her into a canal after she told them she could not swim.
"This case of rape is as horrifying and revolting as any could be," judge Sir Lawrence Verney said before sentencing the gang members, aged from 14 to 17.
An eighth member of the gang, the 14-year-old ring leader, will be sentenced later after psychiatric assessment.

The court heard that the youths -- four blacks, two Filipinos, a Columbian and one who was half-English and half-Greek -- had laughed and delivered racist taunts as they repeatedly raped the 32-year-old mother of two.
They continued to make fun of their victim after throwing her into a canal in north London's Kings Cross area, but she managed to reach the other side and escape.
